prose: NVIDIA added four open-weight checkpoints to Cosmos 3 for interactive world simulation and multi-sensor driving scenes. All are post-trained from Cosmos 3 Nano with 16B trainable parameters under OpenMDW 1.1 (commercial and non-commercial use). For robotics, Sim-Bimanual predicts the visual results of actions and Sim-Transfer turns simulator controls into generated observations. For driving, synchronized camera and LiDAR generation, plus scene and traffic-signal controls, let researchers vary layouts and study a driving policy. Streaming generation links video prediction to ongoing interaction.
highlights: Four open checkpoints, 16B parameters, post-trained from Cosmos 3 Nano
Driving: synchronized camera and LiDAR, scene and signal controls
